title: Prototype a GPU demapper on the shared batch interface
description:
Reuse the shared batch demapper contract to stand up a GPU demapper experiment without changing the high-level modem API.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] A GPU demapper prototype can consume the shared batch demapper shape used by the CPU fast path.
- [ ] The experiment does not require API churn in the public modem surface.
- [ ] The prototype is sufficient to support a real crossover measurement.

## Notes

This task is conditional exploratory work and should not block the CPU scalar and SIMD path.
